comments.text: It is crazily crowded in Jakarta. All roads are jammed in rush hour.

replies.author: @tysoncung
replies.text: It is. Parts of Jakarta are also sinking, which is why Indonesia is building a new capital, Nusantara, on Borneo.

comments.author: @cosmic-minds-origin
comments.text: The density figure is the one that lands: Java is about 128,000 square kilometres, under one percent of Russia's land area, and holds more people than all of it. Most of that is volcanic soil; the same volcanoes that make it dangerous are why it can feed that many.
